title: MongoDB IPO: Nasdaq Debut Campaign
summary: Creative direction for MongoDB's October 2017 Nasdaq debut across Times Square, Nasdaq MarketSite, and national print.
overview: As Creative Director, I led the campaign for MongoDB's October 2017 public listing on Nasdaq under the ticker MDB. The work included a wrap and digital placements on the Nasdaq MarketSite tower, surrounding Times Square screens, and a national print ad, all built around the line "Finally, after 40 years, a real alternative."

projectBrief.context: MongoDB's October 2017 Nasdaq listing, under the ticker MDB, called for a public-facing campaign across out-of-home and print placements.
projectBrief.challenge: The creative needed to mark a major company milestone while communicating MongoDB's position as an alternative to relational databases in a few words.
projectBrief.contribution: As Creative Director, I directed the campaign concept and execution across the Nasdaq MarketSite tower, surrounding Times Square screens, and national print.
projectBrief.approach: The line "Finally, after 40 years, a real alternative" connected the listing moment to MongoDB's challenge to the long-established relational database model.
projectBrief.outcome: The campaign launched for listing day across Nasdaq MarketSite, Times Square screens, and national print.
